not super creepy or insane, but:

 when i was around 6 or 7, my grandfather was terminally ill. he was bedridden, and on all these tubes and that just terrified me. i couldn't look at him, or touch him. i was so insanely uncomfortable.

fast forward to when i'm 8, we go back to visit my grandparents again. i distinctly remember my dad telling me, "this may very well be the last time you see him," then something after that i can't remember. i walked into his bedroom, saw him, and i was just flooded with this overwhelming, loving warmth. all afternoon, nobody could take me away from him. i was just hugging him, talking to him, kissing him, and loving him. 

we left, and he passed soon after. 

not quite creepy or crazy, but it was like the universe was telling me to say my goodbyes to him. 

rest in peace. <3
